title: Golden v1 run manifest
description: Run identity and the assertions declared BEFORE execution. Declaring assertions up front is what stops a run from choosing its own success criteria after seeing the evidence.

run_id.description: Unique per run. Evidence from one run must never be evaluated against another. Null in a template: a manifest that has not run has no identity to state.

resource_id.description: Null in a template: a manifest that has not run has no identity to state.

captured_at.description: When the EVIDENCE was collected. Never overwritten by a later evaluation. Null in a template: a manifest that has not run has no identity to state.

evaluated_at.description: When the gates were re-derived offline. Distinct from captured_at: re-running an evaluator must not restate old evidence as freshly captured. Null in a template: a manifest that has not run has no identity to state.

document_updated_at.description: When the prose was last edited. Date-only values are an explicit pre-contract historical allowance; new records should use date-time.

hypothesis.description: The claim the declared assertions are meant to test. Stated before execution so a run cannot choose what it was asking after seeing the answer.

notes.description: Author commentary. Carries no weight in evaluation.

anyOf.description: Explicit pre-contract retained-run allowance. Historical packages with a sanitized null resource and unverified custody remain schema-valid without rewriting their immutable manifests.
